title.en: Coming to be and ceasing to be keep pace
title.zh: 开始成立与不再成立同步

statement.zh: 有限之中，所计的规定可判定时，开始成立与不再成立同步；这不需要关于展开的前提。
statement.en: In a finite family whose counted determination is decided, coming to be and ceasing to be keep pace; this needs no premise about the unfolding.

laws.zh: 以下对每个依存网成立，不加任何关于它的前提。一个规定跨一步开始成立（之前不成立、之后成立）或不再成立（之前成立、之后不成立）；形成的生起与止息、依存的形成与消解、条件开始与不再作为条件而在，是这同一种变化分别读于活动、依存与水平。
laws.en: The following hold of every web, with no premise about it. A determination comes to be across a step where it fails before and holds after, and ceases to be where it holds before and fails after; a formation arising and ceasing, a dependence forming and dissolving, and a condition coming to stand and ceasing to stand are this one change, read of activity, dependence and standing.

laws.zh: 可判定的规定在某步成立、此后没有一步不再成立，就一直成立；一个形成在某步被支持，在另一步仍被支持，只要它在后者的每个依存在前者都有、所需不更大、条件的水平不更低。
laws.en: A decidable determination that holds and ceases to be at no later step holds on; a formation supported at one step is supported at another where each dependence it has at the other it had at the first, at no greater need, on a condition standing no lower.

laws.zh: 任一段步上，一个量在终点加上其间的全部下降，等于在起点加上其间的全部上升；有限家族的总量连同成员的升降也是如此。
laws.en: Over any stretch of steps, an amount at the end with everything it fell is the amount at the start with everything it rose, and so for the total of a finite family with the rises and falls of its members.

laws.zh: 量不低于零，所以有限家族在一段步上的下降至多比上升多出起点的总量，成员在任意晚的步下降就在任意晚的步上升：每个展开中，有限多个条件的水平持续下降就持续上升。
laws.en: No amount falls below zero, so over a stretch a finite family falls by at most its total at the start more than it rises, and members falling at arbitrarily late steps rise at arbitrarily late steps: in every unfolding, levels of finitely many conditions that keep falling keep rising.

laws.zh: 对一个量，这就是 Becoming.Renewal 中“从某步起不上升的观测量不在任意晚的步下降”。
laws.en: For one amount this is Becoming.Renewal's law that an observable never rising from some step on does not fall at arbitrarily late steps.

laws.zh: 量有界时，上升至多比下降多出每个成员的界，在任意晚的步上升就需要在任意晚的步下降。
laws.en: With the amounts bounded, the family rises by at most its bound per member more than it falls, and rising at arbitrarily late steps needs falling at arbitrarily late steps.

laws.zh: 一个规定只计 0 或 1，两者都适用：任一段步上，有限家族在终点成立的成员连同其间不再成立的，恰是在起点成立的成员连同其间开始成立的；开始成立与不再成立的次数之差不超过成员数；一方复现恰当另一方复现。
laws.en: A determination counts as zero or one, so both hold of it: over any stretch, the members of a finite family holding at the end with those that ceased to be are those holding at the start with those that came to be; comings and ceasings differ by at most the number of members; and each recurs exactly when the other does.

laws.zh: 读于活动（活动可判定）：有限家族的形成在终点活跃的连同其间止息的，恰是在起点活跃的连同其间生起的；它们在任意晚的步生起恰当在任意晚的步止息；形成有限多时，某个形成在任意晚的步生起恰当某个形成在任意晚的步止息：生起复现恰当止息复现。
laws.en: Read of activity, given decidable activity: the members of a finite family of formations active at the end with those that ceased are those active at the start with those that arose; they arise at arbitrarily late steps exactly when they cease at arbitrarily late steps; and with finitely many formations, arising recurs exactly when ceasing does.

laws.zh: 读于水平，不需要任何前提：有限家族的条件在任意晚的步开始作为条件而在，恰当它们在任意晚的步不再作为条件而在。
laws.en: Read of standing, with no premise at all: conditions of a finite family come to stand at arbitrarily late steps exactly when they cease to stand at arbitrarily late steps.

laws.zh: 有限性起作用：不断有新的形成生起而没有一个止息，同时一个水平每步上升、从不下降（Accretion）；一开始都活跃的形成可以一个接一个止息而没有任何生起（Attrition）。
laws.en: Finiteness does the work: ever new formations can arise with none ceasing while a level rises at every step and never falls (Accretion), and formations all active at the start can cease one after another while nothing arises (Attrition).

laws.zh: 活动的规律对每个世界有局部形式：一个列表从某步起覆盖活跃者、活动可判定时，生起复现恰当止息复现；不要形成有限多，Web.unceasing_iff 是它的推论。
laws.en: The activity law holds of every world in a local form: where one list covers the active formations from some step on and activity is decided, arising recurs exactly when ceasing does; finitely many formations in all is not needed, and Web.unceasing_iff is its corollary.

hypotheses.zh: 表示的方法承诺，不是关于展开的前提：变化跨离散的步读出；量是自然数；计数时，被计的规定在每一步可判定（活动的可判定性是相关定理的假设；水平是否为正总可判定，所以 standing_recurs_iff 不需要它）。
hypotheses.en: Commitments of the representation, not premises about the unfolding: change is read across discrete steps; amounts are natural numbers; counting needs the counted determination to be decidable at each step (decidable activity is a hypothesis of the theorems that use it; whether a level is positive is always decidable, so standing_recurs_iff needs none).

hypotheses.zh: 家族有限：以列表给出，可以重复；Accretion 与 Attrition 表明无限家族中两个方向都不成立。上升复现推出下降复现还需要量有界；规定只计 0 或 1，所以总有界。
hypotheses.en: The family is finite, given as a list, possibly with repetition; Accretion and Attrition show that both directions fail for infinite families. That recurring rises need recurring falls also needs the amounts bounded; a determination counts zero or one, so it always is.

does_not_show.zh: “复现”是在任意晚的步出现，不给出频率。
does_not_show.en: Recurring means occurring at arbitrarily late steps and gives no frequency.

does_not_show.zh: 同步是数目的同步，不说明哪个形成生起或止息，也不说明为什么。
does_not_show.en: Keeping pace is of counts and says neither which formations arise or cease nor why.

does_not_show.zh: 不把形式规律当作对现实的演绎必然性。
does_not_show.en: Formal laws are not taken for the deductive necessity of the whole for reality.

does_not_show.zh: 三种读法是同一变化，这不是定义之外的事实：change_readings 由展开定义成立（六个 Iff.rfl）；所检查的内容是有限家族中的同步。
does_not_show.en: That the three readings are one change is no fact beyond the definitions: change_readings holds by unfolding them (six Iff.rfl); the checked content is keeping pace in a finite family.

detail.zh: 无限家族：不断有新的形成生起而没有一个止息，同时一个水平每步上升、从不下降（Accretion）。
detail.en: An infinite family: ever new formations arise with none ceasing, while a level rises at every step and never falls (Accretion).

detail.zh: 无限家族：一开始都活跃的形成一个接一个止息，没有任何生起（Attrition）。
detail.en: An infinite family: formations all active at the start cease one after another while nothing arises (Attrition).

next_delta.zh: 对整个空间成立的规律的完整清单，以及每个前提都有满足与不满足它的展开（Becoming.Space）；下降何时在同一步上就是不再作为条件而在（耗散之下上升与下降在同一交换中，见 rising-and-falling-in-one-exchange）；频率与比例的版本；非离散步的读法。
next_delta.en: A complete list of the laws holding of the whole space, with models and countermodels of every premise (Becoming.Space); when a fall is, at its own step, a ceasing to stand (under dissipation rising and falling are one exchange, see rising-and-falling-in-one-exchange); versions with frequencies or proportions; readings not across discrete steps.

correspondence.zh: Ren 的提议：计入整个空间，包括生成与退化，生成之论或许不需要公理；加上公理，就划出整个空间中的一部分（2026-10-08-theory-of-becoming-priority）。本结果给出对整个空间成立的一组规律：它们对每个依存网成立，没有关于网的假设；以前各模块的规律（Dependent、Balances、Dissipative、Embodied、Carries 之下）都写明前提。其中作者认为最有内容的一条：在有限之中，开始成立与不再成立同步，生起不息恰当止息不息，开始作为条件而在不息恰当不再作为条件而在不息。作者把这读作 Ren 所说“生成、维持、转化、退化与消失在同一展开中”的一种形式内容（AI 论证）：在有限的家族中，没有不伴随止息的不息生起，也没有不伴随生起的不息止息；只有生起而无止息需要无尽的新（Accretion），只有止息而无生起需要无尽的初始（Attrition）。这是活动的读法，英文名称 arising/ceasing 经 Ren 确认（2026-10-09-arising-ceasing-names；中文 生起／止息 是 AI 的译名）；它不是 Ren 提议中的“生成的”“退化的”（Ren 写道“generative和degenerate虽然都在一个becoming model上，但是他们不overlap吧”，以“吧”预设二者不重叠，所以这一读法不是其所指；二者读作对能形成者的扩大与缩小，DELEGATED-CHOICES D2）：这里的开始成立与不再成立在有限之中同步；作为关系的读法见 Web.renewing_not_consuming。“止息”“开始成立”等中文用语是 AI 的提议，按 Ren 的命名规则采用（DELEGATED-CHOICES D36）。
correspondence.en: Ren's proposal: counting the whole space, generative and degenerative, the theory of becoming may need no axiom, and adding axioms defines a part of the whole space (2026-10-08-theory-of-becoming-priority). This result gives a set of laws holding of the whole space: they hold of every web, with no assumption about it, while the laws of the earlier modules (under Dependent, Balances, Dissipative, Embodied, Carries) name their premises. The one the author finds most contentful: in a finite family, coming to be and ceasing to be keep pace, arising is unceasing exactly when ceasing is, and coming to stand exactly when ceasing to stand. The author reads this as one formal content of Ren's scope, formation, persistence, transformation, degeneration and dissolution within one unfolding (an AI argument): in a finite family there is no unceasing arising without unceasing ceasing, and no unceasing ceasing without unceasing arising; arising without ceasing needs ever new formations (Accretion), and ceasing without arising needs endlessly many at the start (Attrition). This is a reading of activity, arising and ceasing being names Ren confirmed (2026-10-09-arising-ceasing-names); it is not the proposal's generative and degenerative (Ren wrote ‘generative和degenerate虽然都在一个becoming model上，但是他们不overlap吧’, a tag question presuming that they do not overlap, so this reading is not what is meant; they read as widening and narrowing what can form, DELEGATED-CHOICES D2): coming to be and ceasing to be keep pace here in a finite family; for the reading as relations see Web.renewing_not_consuming. The Chinese terms proposed for ceasing and coming to be are the AI's, adopted under Ren's naming rule (DELEGATED-CHOICES D36).

detail.zh: 复用生起、不息、上升与下降（Arises、Unceasing、Rises、Falls）与 total。
detail.en: Reuses arising, unceasing generation, rising and falling (Arises, Unceasing, Rises, Falls) and total.

output.zh: 生起消耗有限家族时，不息的生成需要更新复现。
output.en: Where arising depletes a finite family, unceasing generation needs renewal to recur.

input.zh: 不加前提：有限家族中下降复现就需要上升复现；生起复现恰当止息复现。
input.en: With no premise: in a finite family recurring falls need recurring rises, and arising recurs exactly when ceasing does.

conditions.zh: 有限家族；计数时活动可判定。
conditions.en: A finite family; decidable activity for counting.

detail.en: falls_not_recurring is the floor law for one amount (falls_not_recurring_from_floor).

output.zh: 从某步起不上升的观测量只下降有限次。
output.en: An observable never rising from some step on falls only finitely often.

input.zh: 有限家族的下降至多比上升多出起点的总量。
input.en: A finite family falls by at most its total at the start more than it rises.

detail.zh: 复用依存的形成与消解（Forms、Dissolves）与支持（Supported）；它们是同一种变化的读法，支持只经由关系改变。
detail.en: Reuses dependence forming and dissolving (Forms, Dissolves) and support (Supported); these are readings of one change, and support changes only through relations.

output.zh: 依存跨步形成、维持、断裂与消解。
output.en: Dependence forms, holds, breaks and dissolves across steps.

input.zh: 这些都是开始成立与不再成立的读法。
input.en: These are readings of coming to be and ceasing to be.

detail.zh: 复用一段步（steps）与 total 的引理；total_map、total_congr 移入同一节，并新增 total_ones。
detail.en: Reuses stretches of steps (steps) and the total lemmas; total_map and total_congr move into the same section, with total_ones added.

input.en: Rises and falls over a stretch.

detail.zh: 复用开始作为条件而在（ComesToStand）；不再作为条件而在是它的对偶。
detail.en: Reuses coming to stand (ComesToStand); ceasing to stand is its dual.

output.zh: 开始作为条件而在需要给予。

input.zh: 有限家族中，开始作为条件而在复现恰当不再作为条件而在复现，不加前提。
input.en: In a finite family, coming to stand recurs exactly when ceasing to stand does, with no premise.

detail.zh: 整体经由部分的生起而持续；部分是有限家族时，部分的生起不息恰当止息不息，整体经由两者一同持续。
detail.en: A whole persists through the arising of its parts; with a finite family of parts, their arising is unceasing exactly when their ceasing is, so the whole persists through both together.

detail.zh: mark 与 mark_cases 从 Becoming.Reserve 移到这里；储备的计数用它们。
detail.en: mark and mark_cases move here from Becoming.Reserve, whose counting uses them.

detail.zh: 回应其“整体的规律不加前提”一项：这里的规律对每个展开成立。
detail.en: Answers its item on laws of the whole with no premise: these laws hold of every unfolding.

detail.zh: 这里的同步是长程的、不加前提的；在平衡与耗散之下，一次上升在它自己的那一步上就伴随另一个成员的下降。
detail.en: The keeping pace here is long-run and needs no premise; under balance and dissipation a rise is accompanied at its own step by another member's fall.

detail.zh: 那里的规律在不要求判定程序时：开始成立复现时不再成立永不终止，反之亦然；从某步起已定时二者同时复现。
detail.en: This law without a decision procedure: where coming to be recurs, ceasing never stops for good, and conversely; decided from some step on, the two recur together.

history.en: 14 October 2026 readability migration to schema 2 (open-issues plan, stream F: the schema-1 records with the most lint findings): the claim became eleven laws with their declarations; limitations, per-round receipts and process notes went to does-not-show items, standard boundaries, the evidence paragraph and history. No law, premise, status, proof binding or source hash changed. The local restatement in the next step (P60) became law 11; the next step's other items stay, without the round labels P22 and P20. The correspondence's closing sentence (it does not decide the level at which 生生不息 is read, does not show that ceasing is good or bad, does not take formal laws for the deductive necessity of the whole for reality) went to the next step, the no-evaluation key and one does-not-show item. The evidence's note that recurring_accumulates came in P30, with Recurs.accumulates now proved from it, and the theorem count stay in the receipt and the snapshot; the local laws are labelled P57–P61; the author's counterreview is §26 of the integration note, the ninth independent review's corrections §34, the eleventh's §42. Every earlier sentence is mapped in the migration table [coming-and-ceasing-keep-pace.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/development/becoming-general-laws-plan/readability/migrations/coming-and-ceasing-keep-pace.md); the exact earlier record is the last text_versions entry.
